name: Warehouse models
summary: Realistic 3D models for the warehouse demo: textured racks, pallets, desks and the MiR100 mobile robot, as GLB files.
help: Downloads once, from GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com), the warehouse models of AWS RoboMaker's Small Warehouse World (racks with boxes, pallets of goods, a pallet jack, pack desks, a bin; MIT No Attribution licence) and the body of the MiR100 robot from DFKI's mir_robot (BSD-3-Clause). Converts them to GLB (metres, Y-up, textures inside) and keeps them in the worker's data folder (cache/warehouse-kit), so later runs take a second. Gives the GLB files, kit.json (sizes) and LICENSES-warehouse-models.txt. Connect Models to the Warehouse view, and to the Warehouse fleet block so the run starts once the models are ready.

outputs.label: Models
outputs.help: rack_d/e/f, goods_a/c/d, pallet_jack, desk, bin and amr (the robot) as GLB, kit.json, licences
